findings: La relación entre Seoulmal y 표준어 requiere fuentes oficiales de definición y sociolingüística; falta precisión sobre solapamientos y diferencias sin generalizar por ciudad.
limitations: Las fuentes encontradas sostienen algunos sentidos y recomendaciones, pero no todas las extensiones por registro, género, edad, organización o frecuencia.
No hay Evidence canónica completa ni evaluación positiva de assessEntry; no se certifica.

followupSources.title: 표준어 규정
followupSources.reference: National Institute of Korean Language. (n.d.). 표준어 규정 [Standard language regulations]. https://www.korean.go.kr/front/page/pageView.do?mn_id=94&page_id=P000085
followupSources.locator: 표준어 규정 제1항과 국립국어원 해설: 표준어를 현대 서울말로서 널리 쓰이는 교양 있는 말로 규정; 해설은 서울말 전체와 표준어가 동일하지 않음을 구별함.
followupSources.supports: Normative relation between standard Korean and the Seoul variety, and the fact that ordinary Seoul speech is not automatically identical with codified standard language.
followupSources.limitation: Does not support claims about Seoul generational, media, migration or style variation.
